string.text: NVIDIA DLSS anti-aliasing and upscaling (GeForce RTX cards). DLAA: anti-aliasing at full resolution, the best quality. Quality, Balanced, Performance, Ultra Performance: the world is drawn at a lower resolution and rebuilt to the screen's; easier on the video card (not on the CPU: no extra frames in fights). MSAA, SMAA and TAA don't work with DLSS. Applied with a video restart.
